title: (others => '0') initial value reads back as expanded zeros before first write
sourceUrl: internal: handoff §6 item 1 — aggregate-marker initial-value expansion
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Signal `r : std_logic_vector(7 downto 0) := (others => '0')` is read out through port `q`. The enable input is held low, so `r` is never written and stays at its initial value. GHDL emits `00000000` from t=0; Kmila historically emitted the literal 11-char marker string `(others=>0)` (Phase H.1 secondary observation), bench's X-tolerance masked it. After Task A's eager-expansion fix the marker is materialised to `00000000` at synth time.
